name: member__lookup_savings_balance
description: Look up a member's savings balance. Finds a member by member number and returns the current balance of their primary savings share. Returns {savings_balance: decimal}. May instead return a business outcome: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND (No member exists with that number); INVALID_MEMBER_NUMBER (Host rejected the member number format); ACCESS_RESTRICTED (Restricted (e.g. employee) account; needs supervisor override). Risk: safe.

name: member__open_share
description: Open a new share (sub-account) for a member. Opens a share of the given type with an opening deposit and returns the confirmation number. Posts a transaction. Returns {confirmation_number: string, share_id: string}. May instead return a business outcome: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND (No member exists with that number); INVALID_MEMBER_NUMBER (Host rejected the member number format); ACCESS_RESTRICTED (Restricted (e.g. employee) account; needs supervisor override); MINIMUM_DEPOSIT_NOT_MET (Opening deposit below the product minimum). Risk: irreversible.

opening_deposit.description: Opening deposit amount in USD (decimal as string)
